ECONOMICS:USWEI.label: Weekly Economic Index · current revised history

source_definition.name: Weekly Economic Index · current revised history
source_definition.unit: WEI points, scaled to four-quarter GDP growth
source_definition.comparison: weekly reference, scaled to four-quarter GDP growth
source_definition.interpretation: Research index of real economic activity from ten daily/weekly indicators. Its scale is related to four-quarter GDP growth; it is neither realized quarterly GDP nor a forecast. Source reference dates are Saturdays, not release timestamps. Current and labelled vintage columns remain distinct.
source_definition.chart_anchor: publisher Saturday reference date; not publication time

reuse.attribution: Lewis, Daniel J., Mertens, Karel, and Stock, James H., Weekly Economic Index
reuse.underlying_components: Published WEI only; component provider data and redistribution entitlements are not inferred

ECONOMICS:USCPITM.label: 16% trimmed-mean CPI · published year-over-year percent change

source_definition.name: 16% trimmed-mean CPI · published year-over-year percent change
source_definition.interpretation: The publisher interpolated the October and November 2025 monthly changes after the October CPI release was unavailable. Affected monthly changes and YoY windows are explicitly flagged. These are the publisher’s chart values, not an annualization of a monthly rate. The complete chart response is retained. Its headline CPI and core CPI columns are not added as new aliases.
source_definition.vintage: Current revised source history; original release vintages unverified

reuse.adaptation: Original values preserved; reference-period anchors and machine-readable evidence added
